CustomField.description: This field is manually populated by the Sales/RM/CS teams to set a date that they should follow up with a stale record OR follow up with a record who was not ready to begin conversations with Flywire at a certain time. An email alert will be triggered from Marketo on the date set by the Sales team. SAL-4910
